about_the_game:
Embark on a journey in another world... by typing!


Isekat: Crushed by a Computer, My Beloved Kitten is Transported to a Fantasy World where its Typing Skills Save the Kingdom! is a typing game where you play the role of an unfortunate kitten from our world who unexpectedly dies and wakes up in a fantasy world of swords, magic and anthromorphic animal people!

Bird. Reptile. Dog. Cat. Long ago, the four animal kingdoms lived together in harmony. But everything changed when the Dog Kingdom attacked. Beset on all sides, their catpeople captured, and the crown prince catnapped, the Cat Kingdom is forced to resort to dire measures... Summoning a hero from another world.

Armed with a magical laptop-like relic, the instinctive affinity of a cat with keyboards, and your typing fingers, you venture forth as a kitten, the one sole hope of the Cat Kingdom.

In this demo, you will...

🗡️| Fight Enemies, Conquer the Dungeon!

A test of your typing skills (and your clackiness of your keyboard)!

In the dungeon, you do everything with the keyboard: Attack, block, avoid traps, open chests... Can your keyboard keep up?

  • Race the clock! Fight your way through the dungeon to rescue the hostages in time!

  • Speed is key! Type the words before you as quickly as you can!

  • Time your blocks! Fight different kinds of enemies, each with their own attack patterns.

⌨️| Check your Words-per-Minute!

In the Practice Mode, check your typing speed and Words-per-Minute!

  • Shorter words are easier to type; longer words yield more points!
